Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 12
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the GOV.UK page, confusing the “Died” location (Ty Newydd, Llanystumdwy, Caernarvonshire) with the “Born” location. The page clearly states “Born 17 January 1863, Chorlton-on-Medlock, Manchester,” but the Planner concluded the birthplace was Llanystumdwy, leading to the wrong final answer.
